product.title: Oahu Deluxe Grand Circle Island Tour

description.text: A coach circles Oahu from Honolulu, with Diamond Head, the North Shore, the Dole Plantation, and Byodo-In Temple. The day also includes Nu'uanu Pali Lookout, the Halona Blowhole, and Waimea Valley. On the North Shore, Waimea Bay is noted for big-wave surfing since the 1960s. Byodo-In Temple admission and round-trip hotel transport are included. Ocean views, rugged mountains, and history come along on the full-day coach circuit. The temple stop includes admission, and the coach handles the hotel transport both ways.
